reason: Prioritize vdown4-rest3-g128 and mixed3-4-g64 for the two trials. Both test ways to reduce memory below int4 while targeting better quality than uniform 3-bit: the first protects value/down projections plus embedding/head; the second tests whether smaller groups help the previously measured mixed 3/4 recipe, which retained 0.85 quality. These are hypotheses, not established gate passes. No supplied BF16 throughput value verifies throughput retention, and no heldout tasks were measured. Int4 has the strongest observed quality evidence but does not prioritize memory reduction; mixed2-4's high throughput came with zero quality.
